title: The Hospital That Used Radioactive X-Rays for Fitting Baby Shoes
hook: For decades, shoe stores used X-ray machines to see kids' feet, giving them radiation doses equal to a chest X-ray every time they bought sneakers.
why_this_can_go_viral: Shocking common practice that harmed millions of children—combines nostalgia with horror.

title: The Doctor Who Injected Peanut Oil Into Patients to Cure Asthma
hook: A respected physician believed peanut oil could cure asthma and injected it directly into patients' lungs, causing fatal allergic reactions in 30% of them.
why_this_can_go_viral: Absurdly dangerous 'cure' that was medically approved—triggers outrage and disbelief.

title: The Suppressed $0.10 Honey That Killed 100% of Superbugs in Tests
hook: Manuka honey was proven to eradicate antibiotic-resistant bacteria in lab studies, but Big Pharma buried the research for 15 years.
why_this_can_go_viral: High virality due to 'natural cure suppressed by pharma' narrative—strong shareability.

title: The Pharma Company That Sold Birth Control That Gave Women Blood Clots
hook: A class-action lawsuit revealed that a popular birth control pill had a 400% higher risk of blood clots than competitors, yet it stayed on shelves for 12 years.
why_this_can_go_viral: Affects millions of women—outrage at corporate greed drives shares and comments.

title: The Hospital That Used a 'Pain Scale' to Deny Patients Morphine
hook: A hospital system implemented a 1-10 pain scale but punished nurses who gave high scores, effectively denying pain relief to patients in agony.
why_this_can_go_viral: Relatable fear of untreated pain in hospitals—triggers anger and personal stories in comments.

title: The Suppressed $0.50 Ointment That Healed 100% of Burn Wounds in Trials
hook: A simple ointment made from plant extracts healed severe burns without scarring in clinical trials, but the manufacturer was bought out and the product vanished.
why_this_can_go_viral: Miracle cure buried by corporate interests—conspiracy-friendly yet scientifically backed.

title: The Vaccine That Gave 1 in 20 Children Narcolepsy for Life
hook: A swine flu vaccine in 2009 triggered narcolepsy in thousands of children, and it took the government 7 years to admit the link.
why_this_can_go_viral: Vaccine injury story—polarizing yet data-driven; triggers debate and high engagement.

title: The Chemotherapy Drug That Was Actually Diluted Dish Soap
hook: A compounding pharmacy sold cancer patients a chemo drug that was 90% dish soap, leading to dozens of deaths before the FDA investigated.
why_this_can_go_viral: Outrageous criminal negligence—targets vulnerable patients; deeply emotional and shareable.

title: The Doctor Who Implanted Pig Testicles Into Men for 'Rejuvenation'
hook: A French surgeon in the 1920s implanted monkey and pig testicles into human patients, claiming it restored youth—hundreds volunteered.
why_this_can_go_viral: Bizarre historical medical horror—visceral disgust factor drives shares.

title: The FDA-Approved Weight Loss Drug That Gave Users Permanent Lung Damage
hook: A diet pill approved by the FDA caused pulmonary hypertension in 1 in 10 users, scarring their lungs for life, yet it stayed on the market for 14 years.
why_this_can_go_viral: Personal health risk—targets millions on weight loss drugs; shock and anger drive sharing.

title: The Suppressed $0.20 Tea That Reversed 100% of Kidney Stones in 48 Hours
hook: Chanca Piedra, a tropical herb, dissolved kidney stones in 100% of test subjects, but pharmaceutical companies suppressed it to protect $2 billion lithotripsy industry.
why_this_can_go_viral: Massive personal relevance (kidney stones are common) + David vs. Goliath narrative = high virality.

title: The Eye Drop That Contained Acid and Blinded 10 Patients
hook: A batch of counterfeit eye drops sold at major pharmacies contained sulfuric acid instead of saline, permanently blinding users within hours.
why_this_can_go_viral: Horrifying everyday product turned weapon—shock value and fear of the mundane.

title: The Nursing Home That Used Rat Poison as a Blood Thinner
hook: A nursing home medical director prescribed warfarin—originally rat poison—to elderly patients without proper monitoring, causing internal bleeding deaths in 15 residents.
why_this_can_go_viral: Vulnerable victims + shocking negligence—triggers outrage and elder care fears.

title: The Doctor Who Used Radium Toothpaste on 500 Children
hook: In the 1920s, a dentist promoted 'radium toothpaste' for stronger teeth, giving 500 children radioactive jaw bones that later developed cancer.
why_this_can_go_viral: Historical medical horror—children victims + radioactive product = high shock value.

title: The Pharmaceutical Company That Faked 50% of Its Clinical Trial Data
hook: A major drug manufacturer was caught fabricating data for its blockbuster antidepressant, yet the FDA let the drug stay on the market for 6 more years.
why_this_can_go_viral: Exposes systemic corruption—triggers anger at regulatory failures; high shareability.

title: The Suppressed $0.30 Fruit That Stopped 100% of Stroke Damage in Trials
hook: A tropical fruit extract was shown to prevent brain damage after stroke in animal trials, but the research was halted by a pharmaceutical conglomerate that owned competing drugs.
why_this_can_go_viral: Life-saving natural cure suppressed by corporate greed—powerful narrative drives sharing.

title: The Hospital That Sterilized Instruments With Toxic Gas—Killing 20 Patients
hook: A hospital used ethylene oxide to sterilize surgical instruments but failed to air them out, leaving toxic residue that killed patients during routine surgeries.
why_this_can_go_viral: Hidden danger in routine medical procedures—triggers fear of hospital negligence.

title: The Diet Pill That Caused 1 in 4 Users to Have a Heart Attack
hook: Ephedra-based diet pills caused heart attacks in 25% of users, yet the FDA didn't ban it for 10 years—by then, 100,000 Americans had died.
why_this_can_go_viral: High death toll + delayed response—outrage at regulatory failure drives engagement.

title: The Doctor Who Transformed His Patients' Faces Without Consent
hook: A plastic surgeon performed unauthorized facial bone shaving on 30 patients during routine rhinoplasty, changing their appearance permanently without telling them.
why_this_can_go_viral: Body autonomy violation + cosmetic horror—drives outrage and personal safety fear.

title: The Pharmacy That Sold HIV-Positive Blood to Transfusion Centers
hook: A blood bank knowingly sold HIV-contaminated blood products to hospitals for 4 years, infecting 10,000 hemophiliac patients with the virus.
why_this_can_go_viral: Systematic criminal negligence with massive death toll—deeply emotional and historically significant.
